module_summary: Reset synchronizer with test bypass: a shift register of ones releases reset synchronously, with clock muxes selecting test-mode reset sources.

anchors.name: synch_regs_q
anchors.why: Reset-release shift register shifting ones in; last stage drives rst_no and init_no.

anchors.name: test_mode_i
anchors.why: Selects test-mode reset sources over synchronized reset in all three muxes.

anchors.name: init_no
anchors.why: Init-done indication from last synchronizer stage, forced high in test mode.

anchors.name: rst_test_mode_ni
anchors.why: Test-mode reset source muxed onto internal reset and rst_no.

groups.name: Reset synchronizer
groups.description: NumRegs-deep shift register asynchronously cleared, synchronously released.

groups.name: Test bypass muxes
groups.description: Clock muxes choosing functional or test-mode reset for input and outputs.
